# Litmatch feature flows

> Source-backed architecture diagrams and annotated walkthroughs of the difficult backend flows. Generated reading aids; source, service contracts and ADRs own behavior. These files are not executable applications or production-readiness evidence.

## Site structure

- [Feature diagrams](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-feature-flows/): architecture and business/layer flow diagrams, grouped by feature.
- [Code overview](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-feature-flows/code/): difficult endpoint walkthroughs; basic CRUD is intentionally omitted.
- [Structured flows and diagrams](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-feature-flows/ai/flows.json): roles, tables, Redis, related modules, flow order, actual numbered Steps with raw-file line numbers, why-comment evidence (src), and diagram catalogs plus architecture components/protocol edges.

## How to read an annotated flow

- Read from top to bottom in runtime call order. A called function body appears after its call, with a tier header; braces preserve source nesting.
- [CONTROLLER], [SERVICE], [WORKER], [POSTGRES], [REDIS], [KAFKA], [BULLMQ], [EXTERNAL], and [GATEWAY] identify responsibility or infrastructure. Headers name the function and show its source path when the file changes.
- Step N marks the numbered narrative sequence. Use steps in flows.json (generated from each raw .ts) to locate the exact raw-file line; declaredSteps retains catalog anchors.
- Project service, port and helper calls expand into their implementations once per page. The constructor scaffold gathers only used infrastructure dependencies (for example logger, repository, Redis, config), grouped by declaring owner.
- Generated const bindings connect call arguments to expanded function parameters. Simple helper return expressions may be substituted directly. Other implementation lines come from repository source.
- Inline comments answer why a guard, lock, idempotency rule, or side effect exists. Their src evidence is in flows.json whyComments and in the annotated catalog; source headers and the sources list point back to implementation.
- PostgreSQL owns durable state. Redis coordinates queues, indexes and realtime where the flow declares it. Business domains run inside core-api; signaling-gateway transports/fanouts and media-server handles media.
